scope.description: Exactly the eleven numeric/comparison rows currently exposed in the public K4 Cell ledger. This is not an inventory of every K4 claim or paper.

classification_policy.rule: A row already juxtaposed with public measurements, diagnostics or bounds at this inventory cutoff is RETROSPECTIVE. It cannot enter the signed Prediction Registry without a distinct future observable, target release, frozen analysis and falsifier.

claims.reason: The public ledger already displays the proposed value beside the measured value and uncertainty at the inventory cutoff.
